name: Food Bank of Contra Costa & Solano
description: The Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano serves two counties with free food distribution, helping fight hunger through 245+ partner nonprofits and direct community programs.
fullDescription: The Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano serves two counties with free food distribution, helping fight hunger through 245+ partner nonprofits and direct community programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free groceries at partner food pantries (each pantry sets its own eligibility and pick-up rules)
- Mobile pantry distributions with produce, proteins, dairy, and nonperishables
- Community Produce Program (up to 15 pounds of fresh produce twice a month)
- Senior food program for low-income seniors 55+ (twice a month)
- College and school pantries and weekend meals for kids
- CalFresh enrollment assistance
howToGetIt: Use the online Find Food map or city list to locate a distribution site near you, or call 855-309-FOOD (3663). Bring two bags with handles. Call partner pantries to confirm hours; some require proof of address.
keywords: Food Bank Contra Costa, Solano, free food, food pantry, mobile pantry, senior food, produce, CalFresh, food distribution
